title: 电话号码的字母组合
statement: 给定一个只包含数字 2-9 的字符串 digits，按电话按键的映射（2: abc，3: def，4: ghi，5: jkl，6: mno，7: pqrs，8: tuv，9: wxyz）返回它能表示的所有字母组合，顺序任意。数字 1 不对应任何字母。若 digits 为空，返回空列表。
constraints: 1 ≤ digits.length ≤ 4（官方现行约束；旧版题面允许长度为 0）
digits[i] 是 ['2', '9'] 范围内的数字
本地额外包含 digits 为空串的测试，应返回空列表

complexity.space: O(n) 额外空间（回溯递归栈与当前路径，计入递归栈；输出不计入）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为 digits 长度；每个数字最多对应 4 个字母，组合数至多 4^n，每个长度 n。判题忽略组合之间的顺序。

en.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
en.statement: Given a string digits containing only the digits 2-9, return all letter combinations it can represent using the phone keypad mapping (2: abc, 3: def, 4: ghi, 5: jkl, 6: mno, 7: pqrs, 8: tuv, 9: wxyz), in any order. The digit 1 maps to no letters. If digits is empty, return an empty list.
constraints: 1 ≤ digits.length ≤ 4 (current official constraint; an older version of the problem allowed length 0)
digits[i] is a digit in the range ['2', '9']
Locally there is an extra test with an empty digits string, which should return an empty list

complexity.space: O(n) extra space (backtracking recursion stack and current path, recursion stack included; output not counted)
complexity.notes: n is the length of digits; each digit maps to at most 4 letters, so there are at most 4^n combinations, each of length n. The judge ignores the order of the combinations.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: one line, the string digits (may be an empty line). stdout: line 1 is the number of combinations k; then k lines, each with one letter combination (any order).

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：一行字符串 digits（可能为空行）。stdout：第一行组合个数 k；随后 k 行，每行一个字母组合（顺序任意）。
